title: Hearts of the Dungeon List
description:
Check the dungeons off the list and find love! Inspired by classic JRPGs, modern visual novels, and rougelites that value fun and character progression over frustration!STATS, ABILITIES, AND CUSTOMIZATION• Level up to develop your stats, then customize and upgrade your ability set to fit your play-style.
LOVE• Build relationships with characters in town and help the villagers with their problems in story threads that move at your pace.
MONSTERS, DUNGEONS, QUESTS• Overcome over 100 monsters ranging from cute little mushrooms to otherworldly beasts in fast and responsive turn-based combat! Fill out the bestiary, build up the abandoned town, complete character requests, and conquer [over 100] increasingly challenging dungeons!
RELAX• Take a break with side activities such as fishing, and enjoy the passage of time.
FREE POST-RELEASE CONTENT:• Casino: An updated JRPG staple with a twist!

• Expanded Fishing: More in-depth, more fish, and more to do in general!

• Additional Monsters: Raising the total monster count to over 200!

• Endgame Dungeons: Once you've conquered the Dungeon List, the real challenge awaits!

• Addressing Feedback: Got some suggestions? Join the Discord and be heard!
description_short: Conquer dungeons, find romance, upgrade the town, build your stats, or just take it easy in this fast-paced turn-based RPG.
